statuses.reason: NotImplemented marks an operation the mock does not serve yet. A finished mock serves every operation, so 501 is never a correct answer.
GenerateTokenFail is Fonzip's unexpected internal error. Issuing a token in memory cannot fail.

Every API key holds the read scope, so a read operation is never refused for scope, and scope is the only reason these operations document for 403. The excepted operations also refuse for another reason: generateLoginLinkForUser refuses an administrator, and getEcardTransactionList refuses an order_by outside its list.
The operation takes no parameters and no body, so no request to it can fail validation.
The operation names no object in its path or body, so there is nothing that can be missing.

properties.reason: The spec returns refresh_token only for the authorization_code grant, which the mock refuses by decision.
